headline: Executive order adjusting certain federal pay rates, signed at the end of 2004.
what_it_does: This order changes certain rates of pay set by the federal government. Based on the title alone, it appears to be the yearly order that sets new pay rates for groups of federal workers. No summary was provided, so the exact groups covered and the size of any changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under this order, though the specific pay scales and amounts are not given in the provided material.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the provided material; yearly pay orders signed in late December usually apply starting in early January of the next year.
